statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Wednesday's delayed NQ reference recovered materially from the 29,333 session low, and no fresh post-reopen price-path evidence was available at the cutoff. Current evidence therefore does not establish persistent one-way mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is below the WATCH threshold, while Stress remains extreme because Brent settled above $100, the U.S. 10-year yield ended near 4.84%, and major inflation and FOMC checkpoints remain ahead.
headline: Tail returns to low after intraday repair; oil, yields and inflation events keep Stress extreme
body: The latest delayed NQ reference available for the completed U.S. session was 29,460 after a 29,333 low and 29,633.75 high. The Nasdaq Composite closed 0.64% lower, but the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 0.37%, while Brent settled at $101.21 and the U.S. 10-year yield ended near 4.841%. Fresh post-reopen NQ structure was not available at the assessment cutoff.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 18% to 43%. The highest published Tail was 43% during the 14:00 UTC trend-down hour; subsequent repair reduced Tail to 20% by 21:00 UTC. The 12:00 UTC slot has no valid published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The overnight baseline is low Tail if two-sided rotation persists. Risk concentrates around the September 10 PPI release at 12:30 UTC and the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open; elevated forecast Tail is conditional on observed post-release persistence, shallow retracements or repeated extension.

forecast.analysis: The last delayed NQ reference was 29,460 after a 29,333 session low, showing substantial recovery from the intraday extreme. No fresh post-reopen NQ structure was available at the cutoff, so current evidence does not establish persistent one-way mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Wednesday NQ recovered materially from the session low
No fresh post-reopen NQ path was available at the cutoff
Brent above $100 and 10-year yields near 4.84% keep Stress extreme

news.title: Wall Street dips as $100 oil, inflation worries weigh on investors
US Treasury to buy up to $6 billion in Sept 10 buyback operation

forecast.analysis: If the reopened session remains two-sided around Wednesday's closing area, Tail stays low. A geopolitical gap followed by shallow counter-moves and repeated extension would be the main escalation path for this hour.
drivers: Persistence of the current oil/geopolitical backdrop

forecast.analysis: Early Asia keeps a low-Tail baseline if NQ rotates rather than extends efficiently away from the reopen range. A clean break that holds near a new overnight extreme would challenge that baseline.
drivers: Cross-asset confirmation if oil or yields reaccelerate

forecast.analysis: Tail remains low if meaningful retracements interrupt direction during the Asia session. Repeated extension after shallow repairs would be the principal conditional sign that mean reversion is failing.

The Asia session remains low Tail while price discovery is two-sided. Risk would rise if the market carries a directional move through successive pullback attempts without returning toward prior levels.
A quieter mid-Asia hour has a low-Tail baseline. The adverse scenario is a fresh overnight extreme that holds while counter-moves become progressively shallower and macro pressure stays aligned.
drivers: Oil and rates alignment if it persists

forecast.analysis: Late Asia remains low Tail if prior levels continue to trade on both sides. A one-way handoff toward Europe, especially with little retracement, would be the main conditional escalation signal.

The Asia-to-Europe transition stays low Tail if overnight direction loses efficiency. A persistent move that survives the first European liquidity increase with shallow pullbacks would lift realized Tail.
Early Europe has a low-Tail baseline unless the overnight move accelerates as liquidity increases. Confirmation would require persistent NQ structure rather than macro headlines alone.
European follow-through remains below WATCH if price continues to rotate through prior levels. Tail would rise if oil/rates pressure coincides with a sustained NQ move near an overnight extreme.
Mid-Europe remains low Tail if cross-asset pressure does not translate into efficient NQ extension. Persistent directional structure would matter more than the elevated macro backdrop by itself.
drivers: Translation of macro pressure into NQ

forecast.analysis: WATCH risk begins to build as U.S. participation increases. Tail stays near the threshold unless premarket structure becomes one-way or the market holds an extreme with failed retracements.

Premarket sensitivity increases ahead of the inflation window. A two-sided range keeps Tail in WATCH, while efficient extension with weak counter-moves would raise the probability of a pathological path.

The final pre-PPI hour carries high Stress but only WATCH Tail on information known now. A durable break before the release would matter only if current price structure, not event importance alone, confirms persistence.
drivers: Event importance affects Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 12:30 UTC PPI release. Tail remains WATCH on pre-event information; realized Tail would require observed post-release persistence, shallow retracements, or repeated extension rather than the release itself.
drivers: Rates and NQ alignment after the release

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash-open hour is conditionally elevated: Tail reaches this level only if the post-PPI move carries through the 13:30 UTC open with shallow pullbacks or failed retracements. Meaningful repair would invalidate the elevated path quickly.

Post-open Tail remains conditionally elevated if the first-hour move keeps extending and holds near a session extreme. Two-sided auction behavior or a meaningful retracement would argue for a fast reduction in realized Tail.

The continuation checkpoint stays elevated only if directional efficiency survives beyond the opening impulse. If liquidity broadens and price revisits prior levels, realized Tail should move back toward WATCH.
drivers: Breadth and rates confirmation if available

forecast.analysis: WATCH is the baseline if the morning impulse begins to rotate. Continued one-way extension with failed pullbacks would keep Tail elevated; orderly repair would reduce it further.
Late-morning risk remains WATCH if price discovery becomes two-sided. Long-end Treasury sensitivity is a secondary amplifier only if it coincides with renewed directional NQ structure.

Midday Tail remains WATCH if volatility decays and retracements stay meaningful. A second directional leg would require fresh observed extension rather than persistence being assumed from the morning.
The afternoon baseline is WATCH but easing if earlier dislocations have repaired. Tail would re-escalate only on a fresh sequence of extension, extreme holding, and weak counter-moves.
Late-session Tail stays at WATCH if closing flows remain rotational. A renewed one-way move into the cash close would be the main reason for realized risk to remain elevated.

The post-cash-close interval has a low-Tail baseline if futures stabilize. With the CME maintenance window approaching, headline gap risk remains relevant but active one-way price structure cannot be assumed.

forecastDetail.comment: Current evidence shows substantial recovery from Wednesday's low, while fresh post-reopen structure is unavailable; Tail is low and Stress extreme.
If the reopen remains two-sided, low Tail persists; a gap with shallow counter-moves and repeated extension is the adverse path.
Early Asia stays low Tail if rotation continues; holding a fresh overnight extreme would challenge the baseline.
Meaningful retracements keep Tail low; repeated extension after shallow repairs would be the key deterioration signal.
Two-sided Asia price discovery supports low Tail; persistent direction through successive pullbacks would raise risk.
Mid-Asia remains low Tail unless a new extreme holds with progressively shallower counter-moves and aligned macro pressure.
